title: Escape from residential treatment facility.
bodyText: A person placed into a residential treatment facility or program pursuant to this chapter shall be deemed to be subject to official detention for the purposes of a criminal prosecution for violation of section 710-1020 or 710-1021.
bodyHtml: [§353G-11]  Escape from residential treatment facility.  A person placed into a residential treatment facility or program pursuant to this chapter shall be deemed to be subject to official detention for the purposes of a criminal prosecution for violation of section 710-1020 or 710-1021. [L 1998, c 152, pt of §2]
